contract.helper: cleanup_pattern_files(results_dir, cfg, *, lake=None) -> {status, deleted, skipped_tasks, errors}
contract.public_compatibility: run_cleanup returns None; optional keyword-only lake; actual periodic orchestrator passes self.lake. Default empty patterns remain no-op; real legacy scratch JSON/log cleanup retained.
contract.policy: Validate whole pattern batch before deletion. No absolute, upward, backslash, empty/noncanonical patterns; terminal ** remains directory-only/no regular-leaf match.
contract.locking: Candidate directory scan outside per-task effect guard. Acquire existing guard before fresh read-only DB transaction; require agreed closed lifecycle and all current native phases closed. Recheck effect lease before each unlink.
contract.protection: No-follow directory traversal; single-link regular leaves only; exact captured leaf identity before unlink plus parent fsync. Protect framework private trees, configured source/evidence paths, current pinned training outputs, actual authority DB/sidecars and pinned native control tree. Explicit legacy model-lineage artifacts, evaluation checkpoints and resume immutable-input directories are protected at the actual consumer path bases.
contract.authority: No DB bootstrap/migration/state updates. Missing/malformed/conflicting authority refuses task. A truly unbound legacy directory remains compatible; outstanding unconfirmed claim is conservative HOLD.
contract.observable: Only confirmed deletion calls increment deleted; exceptions produce partial/error diagnostics. No claim of transactional filesystem batch rollback.

limits_and_nonclaims: Built-in pattern cleanup only. Existing GC and explicit user cleanup script are separate authority and were not sandboxed or otherwise redesigned.
No director GPU ownership, natural child-process closure/C2, broad artifact GC, or lifecycle migration work.
No large checkpoint/content hashing is performed by cleanup.
Cooperating native claim/reset/begin/publication use the same guard. This is not a hostile external-writer filesystem sandbox or cross-host exactly-once guarantee.
No paid provider, GPU, or holdout used. Destructive repros operated only in pytest temporary directories.
This author report does not claim final whole-Core/Pro test results or independent reviewer sign-off; root records those separately.
No commits or pushes by this subagent.
